summary: Backend fully green (8/8 pytest). Frontend home screen renders, but Scorecard crashes with 'useAnimatedReactions is not a function' — a react-native-reanimated API typo in src/components/dual-gauge.tsx (should be useAnimatedReaction, singular). This blocks the entire analyse->scorecard->save flow via UI.

ui_bugs.issue: Uses `useAnimatedReactions` from react-native-reanimated which does not exist. Correct API is `useAnimatedReaction` (singular). TypeError crashes Scorecard, ErrorBoundary shows 'Something went wrong'.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot verify UI end-to-end because Scorecard render crashes before verdict/gauges/save-btn mount. Backend save endpoint itself is verified via pytest.

react_native_issues.issue: Wrong Reanimated hook name -> hard runtime crash on web/native

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/components/dual-gauge.tsx, replace `useAnimatedReactions` with `useAnimatedReaction` (singular) in both the import from 'react-native-reanimated' and its usage inside Gauge().

After fix, restart expo (sudo supervisorctl restart expo) and re-run UI E2E: text-transcript analyse -> scorecard (gauge values, verdict, trait pills) -> save-to-history -> history list -> open item (read-only) -> delete.

Verified working via UI: home loads, mode switcher (text<->image), person A/B inputs, transcript input, char counter, analyse button disabled until text length>10 (aria-disabled toggles true->none). No issues with home screen padding/contrast on 390x844 viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id via projection ({"_id": 0}) — good.
AnalyzeRequest correctly enforces mode literal and 400 on empty text.
Consider moving CORSMiddleware add before include_router (currently after — still works but conventionally added first).
Consider migrating deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') to lifespan context (FastAPI ≥ 0.109 warning).
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ history item was created and deleted within pytest run — DB left clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0` (xdist parallel breaks the analyze->history dependency; force n=0). After E1 fixes the Reanimated hook name, re-run the full UI flow: paste transcript, click analyze-button, wait up to 60s for verdict-card, verify gauge-a-value/gauge-b-value show integers 0-100, click save-btn, back-btn, history-nav-button, verify history-item-* appears, tap it, verify verdict-card again with no save-btn (read-only), back and delete-*.
rca_of_issue: React Native Reanimated exports `useAnimatedReaction` (singular). The Gauge component imports/uses `useAnimatedReactions` (plural) which is undefined at runtime -> TypeError inside a functional component render -> caught by ErrorBoundary -> user sees red 'Something went wrong' fallback on scorecard route. Fix: rename both the named import and the call site to the singular form. No other component references the wrong name.
